text.headline: Timeline of Zimbabwe
text.text: Major events in the history of Zimbabwe.

events.headline: Great Zimbabwe
events.text: Shona civilization builds the monumental stone city of Great Zimbabwe.

events.headline: Mutapa Empire
events.text: Dominates gold and ivory trade across southern Africa.

events.headline: BSAC Occupation
events.text: Cecil Rhodes’ company occupies the area, naming it Southern Rhodesia.

events.headline: Self-Governing Colony
events.text: Southern Rhodesia becomes a self-governing British colony.

events.headline: UDI
events.text: Ian Smith’s regime declares independence from Britain.

events.headline: Independence
events.text: Zimbabwe gains international recognition; Robert Mugabe becomes PM.

events.headline: Economic Collapse
events.text: Land seizures and hyperinflation trigger decline.

events.headline: Mugabe Ousted
events.text: Military intervention removes Mugabe after 37 years.

events.headline: Mnangagwa Elected
events.text: Elections under new leadership with reform promises.

events.headline: Inflation & Reform Efforts
events.text: Pursuing investment and stability amid economic challenges.
